log._comment: Style Dictionary's built-in name-collision check is a false positive here: color.red/vhs.color.red (and similarly typography.font.head/weight.head/scale.head) intentionally share a terse leaf name across separate branches of the tree. The custom formats in build-tokens.mjs read each branch by its full path (dictionary.tokens.vhs.color.red, etc.), not by this auto-generated name, so there's no actual collision in the output.
